WITH account_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
account_region AS (
  SELECT 
    aa.account_id,
    aa.avg_amount,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM account_avg aa
  JOIN account a ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
region_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(avg_amount) as region_figure
  FROM account_region
  GROUP BY region
),
all_region_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_figure) as global_average
  FROM region_avg
)
SELECT 
  ra.region,
  ra.region_figure,
  ra.region_figure - ara.global_average as exceeds_by,
  ra.region_figure / ara.global_average as ratio
FROM region_avg ra, all_region_avg ara
WHERE ra.region_figure > ara.global_average
ORDER BY ra.region_figure DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Only accounts with at least one transaction in the trans table are included; accounts in the account table with no transactions are excluded from the calculation.

Transaction amounts are averaged as unsigned positive values (per VERIFIED ON THE DATA); the direction indicator (trans.type: PRIJEM/VYDAJ/VYBER) is not applied, and all transaction types are included.
